title: Dashboard
description: A workspace overview: toolbar, metric cards, a themed area chart and a recent-activity list with status badges.

title: Analytics
description: A metrics page: KPI cards, themed area / bar / line charts and a small source breakdown table.

title: Sign In
description: A centered auth card: email + password fields, a remember toggle, a primary submit, an SSO action and a footer link.

title: Sign Up
description: A centered create-account card: name / email / password fields, a terms toggle, a primary submit and an SSO alt.

title: Forgot Password
description: A centered reset card: an email field, a send-reset primary, a confirmation note and a back-to-sign-in link.

title: Settings
description: A section rail with a profile form, preference toggles and a danger zone for destructive account actions.

title: Profile
description: A user profile: an avatar/initials header with bio, an editable details card and a recent-activity list.

title: Data Table
description: A list page: a search + filter + action toolbar, a data table with status badges, and pagination.

title: Team
description: A members list: a search + invite toolbar, a table of users with avatar / role / status badges, row actions and pagination.

title: Create
description: A multi-section create form: text inputs, a select, toggles, a textarea and primary + secondary actions.

title: Checkout
description: A two-column billing page: an order summary on one side, a payment + contact form on the other and a pay primary.

title: Onboarding
description: A multi-step wizard: a 1·2·3 step indicator, the current step’s form fields and Back / Next actions.

title: Pricing
description: Three pricing tiers (Free / Pro / Enterprise) with feature lists, a highlighted recommended tier, CTAs and a billing toggle.

title: Landing
description: A marketing page: a hero with primary / secondary CTAs, a feature grid of cards and a closing CTA band.

title: Empty State
description: A zero-data state: an illustration placeholder, heading, description and a create action — plus a no-search-results variant.
A centered error page: a large 404, a friendly message and back-home + contact-support actions.

title: Chat
description: An AI chat layout: a header with the assistant name, a scrollable alternating message list and a composer with a send button.

title: Gallery
description: A media/asset grid: a search + view-toggle toolbar, a responsive grid of asset cards with tags and a selection state.
